- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Women may begin to see some effects of testosterone therapy within 3-6 months, including increased muscle mass, improved energy levels and mood, and decreased body fat.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Full results of testosterone therapy may take up to 12 months to become apparent.

- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Common side effects of testosterone therapy for women may include:
  1. Acne
  2. Facial and/or body hair growth
  3. Deepening of the voice
  4. Menstrual changes
  5. Mood changes
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Testosterone therapy can have additional side effects, including an increased risk of heart disease, stroke, and breast cancer, especially in older women.
